// diagnostic

E0420

`` `{name}` may be read before it is given a value ``.

What

`` `{name}` may be read before it is given a value ``.

Why

`` `{name}` was declared with `Type{ uninit }`, so no value is available until you write to it — this read could see garbage ``.

Fix

Write to `{name}` on every path before reading it (e.g. fill it via `mut {name}`).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0420: tests/ui/arena/erased_initialization_does_not_leak_past_scope/stderr.

Error [jet.UninitializedRead]: `value` may be read before it is given a value
  --> run.jet:9:11
    |
  9 |     print(value)
    |           ^^^^^
 Why: `value` was declared with `Type{ uninit }`, so no value is available until you write to it — this read could see garbage
 Fix: Write to `value` on every path before reading it (e.g. fill it via `mut value`)
